name: Roslyn C# Context Indexing
purpose: Build and query code-context indexes for C#/.NET solutions with Roslyn: MSBuild workspace loading, semantic-model symbol extraction, reference/implementation search, type-hierarchy expansion, and document-version incremental reindexing.
inputs: Solution or project path with target frameworks and Roslyn version 4.11 or newer
.NET 8 SDK availability for MSBuildLocator workspace loading
Token budget caps for query answers (max symbols and max tokens)
Golden symbol set covering overloads, explicit implementations, and generics
outputs: Loaded Roslyn solution with per-project load diagnostics report
Queryable symbol, reference, implementation, and type-hierarchy index
stop_conditions: Golden symbol recall reaches 100% with query p95 under 300 ms on a warm solution
Single-document edit reindexes in under 4 seconds including dependents
